title: Hanuma reveals himself to be a messenger of
introduction: Hearing the words of the grief-stricken Seetha, Hanuma reveals himself to be a messenger of Rama and repeats the enquiries made by Rama, Lakshmana and Sugreeva. Seetha, however, suspects Hanuma to be Ravana in disguise and chides him when Hanuma approaches nearer to her. Seetha then asks Hanuma to describe the good qualities of Rama. Hanuma on his part discloses to her his actuality as a minister of Sugreeva and tells the important qualities of Rama. He requests her to have faith in his words.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे चतुस्त्रिंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 34th Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
तस्याः तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा हनूमान् हरि यूथपः |
दुह्खात् दुह्ख अभिभूतायाः सान्तम् उत्तरम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tasyāḥ tat vacanam śrutvā hanūmān hari yūthapaḥ |
duhkhāt duhkha abhibhūtāyāḥ sāntam uttaram abravīt
verses.translation: Hearing those words of Seetha who was overthrown from one grief to another, Hanuma the best of monkeys gave the following reply in a kindly and affectionate manner.

glosses.meaning: who was overthrown from one grief to another

verses.devanagari:
अहम् रामस्य संदेशात् देवि दूतः तव आगतः |
वैदेहि कुशली रामः त्वाम् च कौशलम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
aham rāmasya saṃdeśāt devi dūtaḥ tava āgataḥ |
vaidehi kuśalī rāmaḥ tvām ca kauśalam abravīt
verses.translation: "O Seetha the daughter of the king of Videha Kingdom! I have come here as your messenger on Rama's directions. The virtuous Rama enquired about your welfare too."

verses.devanagari:
यो ब्राह्मम् अस्त्रम् वेदान् च वेद वेदविदाम् वरः |
स त्वाम् दाशरथी रामो देवि कौशलम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
yo brāhmam astram vedān ca veda vedavidām varaḥ |
sa tvām dāśarathī rāmo devi kauśalam abravīt
verses.translation: "O Divine Lady! Rama the son of Dasaratha, who is excellent among the knowers of Veda and who knows Brahma's missile (a mythical weapon which deals infallible destruction) and Vedas the sacred knowledge, enquired about your welfare."

glosses.meaning: Brahma's missile (a mythical weapon which deals infallible destruction)

verses.devanagari:
लक्ष्मणः च महातेजा भर्तुः ते अनुचरः प्रियः |
कृतवान् शोक सम्तप्तः शिरसा ते अभिवादनम्
verses.iast:
lakṣmaṇaḥ ca mahātejā bhartuḥ te anucaraḥ priyaḥ |
kṛtavān śoka samtaptaḥ śirasā te abhivādanam
verses.translation: "Also the greatly splendourous Lakshmana, the favourite brother and the follower of your husband, himself tormented with grief, performed salutation to you by bowing his head."

verses.devanagari:
सा तयोः कुशलम् देवी निशम्य नर सिम्हयोः |
प्रीति सम्हृष्ट सर्व अन्गी हनूमान्तम् अथ अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
sā tayoḥ kuśalam devī niśamya nara simhayoḥ |
prīti samhṛṣṭa sarva angī hanūmāntam atha abravīt
verses.translation: Hearing that news of welfare of Rama and Lakshmana the excellent of men, the divine lady, with all her limbs thrilled with joy, spoke to Hanuma (as follows):

glosses.meaning: of Rama and Lakshmana the excellent among men
with all her limbs thrilled with joy

verses.devanagari:
कल्याणी बत गथा इयम् लौकिकी प्रतिभाति मे |
एहि जीवन्तम् आनदो नरम् वर्ष शतात् अपि
verses.iast:
kalyāṇī bata gathā iyam laukikī pratibhāti me |
ehi jīvantam ānado naram varṣa śatāt api
verses.translation: " 'Joy rushes to surviving man even though (it be) as the end of a hundred years' - this popular adage appears true and and auspicious for me."

glosses.meaning: even though (it be) at the end of a hundred years

verses.devanagari:
तयोः समागमे तस्मिन् प्रीतिः उत्पादिता अद्भुता |
परस्परेण च आलापम् विश्वस्तौ तौ प्रचक्रतुः
verses.iast:
tayoḥ samāgame tasmin prītiḥ utpāditā adbhutā |
paraspareṇa ca ālāpam viśvastau tau pracakratuḥ
verses.translation: Seetha showed wonderful friendly disposition towards Hanuma who approached her. Both of them also conversed with each other in full confidence.

verses.devanagari:
तस्याः तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा हनूमान् हरि यूथपः |
सीतायाः शोक दीनायाः समीपम् उपचक्रमे
verses.iast:
tasyāḥ tat vacanam śrutvā hanūmān hari yūthapaḥ |
sītāyāḥ śoka dīnāyāḥ samīpam upacakrame
verses.translation: Hearing that reply of Seetha who was afflicted with grief, Hanuma the army-chief of monkeys endeavoured to draw nearer to her.

verses.devanagari:
यथा यथा समीपम् स हनूमान् उपसर्पति |
तथा तथा रावणम् सा तम् सीता परिशन्कते
verses.iast:
yathā yathā samīpam sa hanūmān upasarpati |
tathā tathā rāvaṇam sā tam sītā pariśankate
verses.translation: In as much as that Hanuma drew nearer to her, in the same way, that Seetha suspected him as Ravana.

verses.devanagari:
अहो धिग् धिग् कृतम् इदम् कथितम् हि यत् अस्य मे |
रूप अन्तरम् उपागम्य स एव अयम् हि रावणः
verses.iast:
aho dhig dhig kṛtam idam kathitam hi yat asya me |
rūpa antaram upāgamya sa eva ayam hi rāvaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "O shame! It was my guilt to tell him all this to him. He is indeed that Ravana, who obtained another guise."

verses.devanagari:
ताम् अशोकस्य शाखाम् सा विमुक्त्वा शोक कर्शिता |
तस्याम् एव अनवद्य अन्गी धरण्याम् समुपाविशत्
verses.iast:
tām aśokasya śākhām sā vimuktvā śoka karśitā |
tasyām eva anavadya angī dharaṇyām samupāviśat
verses.translation: That Seetha, having faultless limbs, leaving that branch of Ashoka tree and as emaciated with grief, sat down on that ground itself.

verses.devanagari:
हनुमानपि दुःखार्तां तां दृष्ट्वा भयमोहिताम् |
अवन्दत महाबाहुः ततः ताम् जनक आत्मजाम्
सा च एनम् भय वित्रस्ता भूयो न एव अभ्युदैक्षत |
verses.iast:
hanumānapi duḥkhārtāṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayamohitām |
avandata mahābāhuḥ tataḥ tām janaka ātmajām
sā ca enam bhaya vitrastā bhūyo na eva abhyudaikṣata |
verses.translation: Seeing Seetha afflicted with grief and deluded with fear, the great armed Hanuma also then simply saluted her. She too, trembling with fear, did not look towards him again.

verses.devanagari:
तम् दृष्ट्वा वन्दमानम् तु सीता शशि निभ आनना
अब्रवीत् दीर्घम् उच्छ्वस्य वानरम् मधुर स्वरा |
verses.iast:
tam dṛṣṭvā vandamānam tu sītā śaśi nibha ānanā
abravīt dīrgham ucchvasya vānaram madhura svarā |
verses.translation: Seetha, with her countenance resembling the moon, seeing Hanuma saluting her, had a deep sigh and spoke to Hanuma in a sweet-sounding voice (as follows)

glosses.meaning: with her countenance resmbling the moon

verses.devanagari:
मायाम् प्रविष्टो मायावी यदि त्वम् रावणः स्वयम्
उत्पादयसि मे भूयः सम्तापम् तन् न शोभनम् |
verses.iast:
māyām praviṣṭo māyāvī yadi tvam rāvaṇaḥ svayam
utpādayasi me bhūyaḥ samtāpam tan na śobhanam |
verses.translation: "If you are Ravana, who made use of an illusive guise and yourself a conjurer, you are causing me a further agony. It is no good."

verses.devanagari:
स्वम् परित्यज्य रूपम् यः परिव्राजक रूपधृत्
जन स्थाने मया दृष्टः त्वम् स एव असि रावणः |
verses.iast:
svam parityajya rūpam yaḥ parivrājaka rūpadhṛt
jana sthāne mayā dṛṣṭaḥ tvam sa eva asi rāvaṇaḥ |
verses.translation: 'You are indeed the same Ravana, who, abandoning your real form, appeared to me in the guise of a vagrant religious mendicant in Janasthana."

glosses.meaning: in the guise of a vagrant religious mendicant

verses.devanagari:
उपवास कृशाम् दीनाम् काम रूप निशा चर
सम्तापयसि माम् भूयः सम्तापम् तन् न शोभनम् |
verses.iast:
upavāsa kṛśām dīnām kāma rūpa niśā cara
samtāpayasi mām bhūyaḥ samtāpam tan na śobhanam |
verses.translation: "O demon who can assume any form at your will! It is no good that again you are causing agony to me, emaciated because of fasting and feeling very miserable."

glosses.meaning: who can assume any form at will!

verses.devanagari:
अथवा नैतदेवं हि यन्मया परिशङ्कितम्
मनसो हि मम प्रीतिरुत्पन्ना तव दर्शनात् |
verses.iast:
athavā naitadevaṃ hi yanmayā pariśaṇ^kitam
manaso hi mama prītirutpannā tava darśanāt |
verses.translation: "Otherwise, whatever is suspected by me is not indeed true because in my mind, a pleasurable sensation indeed occurred by reason of your audience."

verses.devanagari:
यदि रामस्य दूतः त्वम् आगतो भद्रम् अस्तु ते
पृच्छामि त्वाम् हरि श्रेष्ठ प्रिया राम कथा हि मे |
verses.iast:
yadi rāmasya dūtaḥ tvam āgato bhadram astu te
pṛcchāmi tvām hari śreṣṭha priyā rāma kathā hi me |
verses.translation: "If you have come as Rama's messenger, may you be blessed! O the best of monkeys! Rama's anecdote is very pleasurable for me. Hence, I am requesting you to narrate it."

verses.devanagari:
गुणान् रामस्य कथय प्रियस्य मम वानर
चित्तम् हरसि मे सौम्य नदी कूलम् यथा रयः |
verses.iast:
guṇān rāmasya kathaya priyasya mama vānara
cittam harasi me saumya nadī kūlam yathā rayaḥ |
verses.translation: "O monkey! Narrate the qualities of my beloved Rama. O gentle one! You are eroding my mind as a rapid course of stream erodes a river bank."

glosses.meaning: as a rapid course of steram nadii kuulam = (erodes) a river-bank.

verses.devanagari:
अहो स्वप्नस्य सुखता या अहम् एवम् चिर आहृता
प्रेषितम् नाम पश्यामि राघवेण वन ओकसम् |
verses.iast:
aho svapnasya sukhatā yā aham evam cira āhṛtā
preṣitam nāma paśyāmi rāghaveṇa vana okasam |
verses.translation: "I, who was taken away long ago, is seeing a monkey sent by Rama in this way. Alas! How delightful this dream is!'

verses.devanagari:
स्वप्नेऽपि यद्यहम् वीरं राघवम् सहलक्ष्मणम्
पश्येयम् नावसीदेयम् स्वप्नोऽपि मम मत्सरी |
verses.iast:
svapne'pi yadyaham vīraṃ rāghavam sahalakṣmaṇam
paśyeyam nāvasīdeyam svapno'pi mama matsarī |
verses.translation: "If I have seen the eminent Rama together with Lakshmana, I would not have disheartened. In my case, even my dream is wicked!"

verses.devanagari:
न अहम् स्वप्नम् इमम् मन्ये स्वप्ने दृष्ट्वा हि वानरम्
न शक्यो अभ्युदयः प्राप्तुम् प्राप्तः च अभ्युदयो मम |
verses.iast:
na aham svapnam imam manye svapne dṛṣṭvā hi vānaram
na śakyo abhyudayaḥ prāptum prāptaḥ ca abhyudayo mama |
verses.translation: "I do not deem it as a dream. Seeing a monkey in a dream does not bring about prosperity But prosperity has come to me!"

verses.devanagari:
किम् नु स्याच् चित्त मोहो अयम् भवेत् वात गतिः तु इयम्
उन्मादजो विकारो वा स्यात् इयम् मृग तृष्णिका |
verses.iast:
kim nu syāc citta moho ayam bhavet vāta gatiḥ tu iyam
unmādajo vikāro vā syāt iyam mṛga tṛṣṇikā |
verses.translation: "How possibly is it a delusion of my mind? Is it an impending course of flatulence or changing mental condition of madness? Is it a looming mirage?"

glosses.meaning: a delusion of my mind? iyan bhavet = is it the impending
course of a flatulence? vikaarovaa = or change of mental condition

verses.devanagari:
अथवा न अयम् उन्मादो मोहो अपि उन्माद लक्ष्मणः
सम्बुध्ये च अहम् आत्मानम् इमम् च अपि वन ओकसम् |
verses.iast:
athavā na ayam unmādo moho api unmāda lakṣmaṇaḥ
sambudhye ca aham ātmānam imam ca api vana okasam |
verses.translation: "Otherwise, it is neither madness nor even a delusion, which is a symptom of madness. Because I am knowing about myself as also about this monkey."

glosses.meaning: which is a symptom of madness

verses.devanagari:
इति एवम् बहुधा सीता सम्प्रधार्य बल अबलम्
रक्षसाम् काम रूपत्वान् मेने तम् राक्षस अधिपम् |
verses.iast:
iti evam bahudhā sītā sampradhārya bala abalam
rakṣasām kāma rūpatvān mene tam rākṣasa adhipam |
verses.translation: Thus deliberating upon the strengths and weaknesses in several ways, Seetha finally imagined him to be Ravana, as demons can change their forms at will.

glosses.meaning: as they can change their forms at will.

verses.devanagari:
एताम् बुद्धिम् तदा कृत्वा सीता सा तनु मध्यमा
न प्रतिव्याजहार अथ वानरम् जनक आत्मजा |
verses.iast:
etām buddhim tadā kṛtvā sītā sā tanu madhyamā
na prativyājahāra atha vānaram janaka ātmajā |
verses.translation: Then, that slender waisted Seetha, the daughter of Janaka, thus having made up her mind, did not reply in return anything further to Hanuman.

glosses.meaning: thus having made up her mind

verses.devanagari:
सीतायाः चिन्तितम् बुद्ध्वा हनूमान् मारुत आत्मजः
श्रोत्र अनुकूलैः वचनैः तदा ताम् सम्प्रहर्षयत् |
verses.iast:
sītāyāḥ cintitam buddhvā hanūmān māruta ātmajaḥ
śrotra anukūlaiḥ vacanaiḥ tadā tām sampraharṣayat |
verses.translation: Understanding the contemplation of Seetha, Hanuma the son of wind-god then brought about a great joy in her with his words most favourable to her ears (as follows):

verses.devanagari:
आदित्य इव तेजस्वी लोक कान्तः शशी यथा
राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य देवो वैश्रवणो यथा |
विक्रमेण उपपन्नः च यथा विष्णुः महायशाः
verses.iast:
āditya iva tejasvī loka kāntaḥ śaśī yathā
rājā sarvasya lokasya devo vaiśravaṇo yathā |
vikrameṇa upapannaḥ ca yathā viṣṇuḥ mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: "Rama has a great splendour like that of the sun. He is pleasing to all like the moon. As Kubera the Lord of wealth, he is a lord to the entire world. Like Vishnu, he is greatly renowned and endowed with valour."

glosses.meaning: like Kubera the lord of wealth

verses.devanagari:
सत्य वादी मधुर वाग् देवो वाचस्पतिः यथा |
रूपवान् सुभगः श्रीमान् कन्दर्प इव मूर्तिमान्
verses.iast:
satya vādī madhura vāg devo vācaspatiḥ yathā |
rūpavān subhagaḥ śrīmān kandarpa iva mūrtimān
verses.translation: "Rama is a speaker of truth. Like Lord Brihaspati, he has a sweet voice. He is a handsome man, possessing good fortune and a royal dignity. He is a personified Manmadha, the lord of love."

verses.devanagari:
स्थान क्रोध प्रहर्ता च श्रेष्ठो लोके महारथः |
बाहुच् चायाम् अवष्टब्धो यस्य लोको महात्मनः
verses.iast:
sthāna krodha prahartā ca śreṣṭho loke mahārathaḥ |
bāhuc cāyām avaṣṭabdho yasya loko mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: "Rama gets anger only at right time. He strikes a befitting person at a right time. He is an excellent chariot-warrior. The world is resting under the shelter of arms of this high souled man."

glosses.meaning: (Rama) gets anger at the right time

verses.devanagari:
अपकृश्ष्य आश्रम पदान् मृग रूपेण राघवम् |
शून्ये येन अपनीता असि तस्य द्रक्ष्यसि यत् फलम्
verses.iast:
apakṛśṣya āśrama padān mṛga rūpeṇa rāghavam |
śūnye yena apanītā asi tasya drakṣyasi yat phalam
verses.translation: "Showing an illusory antelope, Ravana detracted Rama and took you away from a deserted hermitage. You will see later, the consequence Ravana will get for this act."

glosses.meaning: by means of an illusory antelope

verses.devanagari:
नचिरात् रावणम् सम्ख्ये यो वधिष्यति वीर्यवान् |
रोष प्रमुक्तैः इषुभिः ज्वलद्भिः इव पावकैः
तेन अहम् प्रेषितो दूतः त्वत् सकाशम् इह आगतः |
त्वत् वियोगेन दुह्ख आर्तः स त्वाम् कौशलम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
nacirāt rāvaṇam samkhye yo vadhiṣyati vīryavān |
roṣa pramuktaiḥ iṣubhiḥ jvaladbhiḥ iva pāvakaiḥ
tena aham preṣito dūtaḥ tvat sakāśam iha āgataḥ |
tvat viyogena duhkha ārtaḥ sa tvām kauśalam abravīt
verses.translation: "Which valiant Rama with arrows strongly shining like sparkles released with anger, by the same Rama I was sent here as a messenger and I arrived at your presence. That Rama, agonised by your separation wishes to enquire of your welfare."

verses.devanagari:
लक्ष्मणः च महातेजाः सुमित्र आनन्द वर्धनः |
अभिवाद्य महाबाहुः सो अपि कौशलम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
lakṣmaṇaḥ ca mahātejāḥ sumitra ānanda vardhanaḥ |
abhivādya mahābāhuḥ so api kauśalam abravīt
verses.translation: "That long-armed Lakshmana too, having a great splendour and who augments the happiness of Sumitra his mother, saluted you and enquired about your welfare."

glosses.meaning: who augments the happiness of Sumitra his mother

verses.devanagari:
रामस्य च सखा देवि सुग्रीवो नाम वानरः |
राजा वानर मुख्यानाम् स त्वाम् कौशलम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
rāmasya ca sakhā devi sugrīvo nāma vānaraḥ |
rājā vānara mukhyānām sa tvām kauśalam abravīt
verses.translation: "O princess! That monkey called Sugreeva, a companion of Rama and the king of the excellent monkeys, asked about your welfare."

glosses.meaning: O Princess! saH vaanaraH = that monkey

verses.devanagari:
नित्यम् स्मरति रामः त्वाम् ससुग्रीवः सलक्ष्मणः |
दिष्ट्या जीवसि वैदेहि राक्षसी वशम् आगता
verses.iast:
nityam smarati rāmaḥ tvām sasugrīvaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ |
diṣṭyā jīvasi vaidehi rākṣasī vaśam āgatā
verses.translation: "Rama, together with Sugreeva and Lakshmana, is always recollecting you. O Seetha! Eventhough coming into the control female-demons, you are somehow surviving by your good luck!"

verses.devanagari:
नचिरात् द्रक्ष्यसे रामम् लक्ष्मणम् च महारथम् |
मध्ये वानर कोटीनाम् सुग्रीवम् च अमित ओजसम्
verses.iast:
nacirāt drakṣyase rāmam lakṣmaṇam ca mahāratham |
madhye vānara koṭīnām sugrīvam ca amita ojasam
verses.translation: "Within a few days, you will see Rama, the mighty Lakshmana and the highly splendorous Sugreeva, in the presence of crores of monkeys."

verses.devanagari:
अहम् सुग्रीव सचिवो हनूमान् नाम वानरः |
प्रविष्टो नगरीम् लन्काम् लन्घयित्वा महाउदधिम्
verses.iast:
aham sugrīva sacivo hanūmān nāma vānaraḥ |
praviṣṭo nagarīm lankām langhayitvā mahāudadhim
verses.translation: "I am a monkey, the minister of Sugreeva, called Hanuma. I entered the city of Lanka, by traversing the great ocean."

verses.devanagari:
कृत्वा मूर्ध्नि पद न्यासम् रावणस्य दुरात्मनः |
त्वाम् द्रष्टुम् उपयातो अहम् समाश्रित्य पराक्रमम्
verses.iast:
kṛtvā mūrdhni pada nyāsam rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ |
tvām draṣṭum upayāto aham samāśritya parākramam
verses.translation: "Asserting my strength and putting down my feet on the head of the evil minded Ravana, I have come to see you."

verses.devanagari:
न अहम् अस्मि तथा देवि यथा माम् अवगच्छसि |
विशन्का त्यज्यताम् एषा श्रद्धत्स्व वदतो मम
verses.iast:
na aham asmi tathā devi yathā mām avagacchasi |
viśankā tyajyatām eṣā śraddhatsva vadato mama
verses.translation: "O Princess! I am not so, as you comprehend me (as Ravana). Let your suspicion be given up. Believe me as I say it."

glosses.meaning: let this suspicion be given up
